notes.title: Shardlight Commentary Achievement Hotfix
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue with commentary achievement it's now more lenient.

You can turn it off and on as many times as you want but ONLY in the main menu.
Turn it ON and start the game, but never turn it off till you see the credits to get the achievement.

notes.title: Shardlight - Engine Patch
notes.notes:
Hi,

We're upgrading the game to 3.6 version of AGS, which basically means better rendering, better support for resolutions and better support for keyboard and mouse!

The savegames have been tested and should work, and shouldn't break.
If for any reason there's an issue, feel free to report and opt in to beta oldversion, by using the password "oldversionold"
